integrity: The universal polynomial is proved using the radical-square-zero commutator matrix, graphic incidence ranks, and finite-field additive-character orthogonality. Direct multiplication-table enumerations independently check 13 finite cases; no external validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: For connected simple unicyclic underlying graphs with one arrow per edge only; finite fields; counts elements rather than centralizer isomorphism types. No multicyclic classification or publication-priority guarantee.
title: The adjoint-rank polynomial of a unicyclic radical-square-zero quiver algebra detects cycle length
